'''Sean Baker Maelstrom the Merchant Deck''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Sean Baker]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-13966">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/13966 Maelstrom the Merchant Deck], DeckTech (sean "IhateAlbany1" baker, 24 February 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/13966/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/13966/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018044209/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/13966/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Sean Baker]]
* '''Published:''' 24 February 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Maelstrom the Merchant Deck''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Local Uprising / Liberation|SE-L-localuprising.gif|label=Local Uprising}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR2 LU Baker LS 2001 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' This deck cyclesthrough your entire reserve deckin two turns allowing you to setup massive battles, drains andregeneration before the opponentcan react.
